title: Star Post
tagline: One launch. Gravity does the rest.
description: Oddvale’s post office has gone orbital. Pull back, let go, and watch gravity bend your odd little robot courier round planets, through every floating mailbox and into the dock. 30 hand-built systems of rubber moons, boost gates, wormholes and wandering planets, plus a new Daily delivery for everyone each day.
coverAlt: Illustration: an odd little robot in a tiny rocket capsule loops around colourful planets on a long dotted curving path, posting letters into floating mailboxes on the way to a space post office.
